principles.name: Single source of truth
principles.detail: Alarm limits live in one file that the simulation, the trend labels, the stat tiles and the header badge all read. Chart colors come from the theme variables through one hook. Routes come from one list.

principles.name: DRY
principles.detail: What each tone (success, warning, error) looks like is defined once, as CSS classes. Every component that shows a tone uses them.

principles.name: State in hooks, components presentational
principles.detail: The only timer is in one hook. Components and pages take props and render.

principles.name: No inline styles
principles.detail: All styling is in CSS classes, and a test fails if a style prop appears.

principles.name: Typed and exhaustive
principles.detail: Adding a page without its label or component is a compile error, not a blank screen.

principles.name: Tested
principles.detail: A test file sits next to each component, page and helper.
